description: L1 · Textbook Fick: one constant D, fixed size, surface at the final water capacity from t = 0
L2 · + Starch state: water capacity and D change only where starch has gelatinized (needs heat and water)
L3 · + Swelling: shells grow as they take up water, so the grain boundary moves
L4 · + Temperature: D follows an Arrhenius law with the local temperature
